messages:
Leah CS: Heads-up: Artemis Labs triggered a large token burn during onboarding. Need a short QBR-ready summary + mitigation plan.
cost-bot: Alert: account=Artemis Labs usage +3.6x in 24h, projected 7-day burn +420% :warning:
Marco (CSM): Any clue what caused it? Bulk import? heavy similarity scans?
Leah CS: They ingested a customer dataset then ran multiple similarity jobs. Snapshot: 24h_total_tokens=2,150,432, avg_per_call=43,210, calls=49, large_jobs=3.
Priya Finance: If trend holds, credits exhausted in ~9 days. I'll run a 30-day forecast but assume mitigations.
Samir Eng: Quick mitigation we can flip now: route embedding-heavy traffic to cheaper embed model + enable batching and prefix caching. Proposed: route->tiny-embed-v2, batch_size=64, cache_prefix=on, throttle=60rps.
Marco (CSM): I'll draft customer note to propose 7-day throttle + short enablement. Need plain language and cost impact.
Nora Product: QBR talking points: root cause (bulk ingestion), immediate fixes (throttle, model swap, batching), longer-term (precompute, scheduled reindex, quota guardrails). Add savings estimates.
Leah CS: Actions: Marco message customer (ETA 2pm PT); Samir implement routing + rollback (ETA EOD); Priya update 30-day forecast and flag renewal risk (ETA 4pm); Nora slide for QBR.
Priya Finance: Also adding temporary budget alerts at 60% and 90% of commit.
Samir Eng: Rolling a canary now, will post results.
Marco (CSM): Draft to Artemis: "Weve observed elevated embedding runs after your data import. To protect your credits we suggest a short throttle and temporary switch to a cost-optimized embedding model while we do a 30-45m enablement session to optimize queries." Please approve/soften.
Leah CS: Approved. Offer a session this week.
cost-bot: Incident logged: INC-2023159 for Artemis Labs, severity=medium, owner=Marco (CSM).
Marco (CSM): Sent to customer; they ACKed and agreed to throttle + session. They asked about a temporary credit expansion if needed.
Priya Finance: Modeling cushion now, will paste forecast link when ready.
Samir Eng: Canary summary: canary_ok=true, median_latency_change=+12ms, token_savings_est~=58% on embedding ops, errors=0/500. Rolling to prod in 30m.
Leah CS: Great. Capture numbers for QBR slide. Closing loop once forecast posted. Thanks all :thumbsup:
